arrest_intro.streak_trigger: Three consecutive errors this shift. The State has flagged your booth for review.
arrest_intro.total_trigger: Five errors this shift. The State has flagged your booth for review.

arrest_verdict: Your replacement is already at the gate.
You will not see your family again.

arrest_note_callback.note_read: I told you we'd meet again.
arrest_note_callback.note_ignored: You should have read the note, Inspector.

promoted_clean: The Inspector comes to your booth. For once he isn't here to question you. He's here to send you home.
"Inspector Selim-X. Good numbers today. Report to Senior Review on Monday. We could use more people who watch the gate the way you do."
You grab your coat. By the time you reach the elevator, someone else is already sitting in your chair.
You're moving up. Whatever that means up here.
promoted_dark: The Inspector comes to your booth. For once he isn't here to question you. He's here to send you home.
"Inspector Selim-X. Good numbers today. Report to Senior Review on Monday."
He hands your ledger back. "Everything balances. A little too neatly, even. We'll be in touch."
You're moving up. There's more than one way to climb in this city.
continue_shift: The Inspector's footsteps fade past your booth. You're left alone with next week's directives. Already updated. Already longer.
